== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata 3)]] (Virtual Block 7.1), showing the '''PC-E3''' game text. The only published image of this text is the Master List slip, which has a blank art box; the other versions of the card are [[Massassi Base Sentry]] (original); [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata)]] (PC-E1); [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), official text as of 27 April 2013 ([[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf]]).
* '''PC-E3 text:''' “Deploy on Yavin 4; it is 'liberated'. During battles at sites related to other 'liberated' systems, may add 2 to power of each Rebel warrior (to a maximum of 4). Once per turn, if you control this system, may retrieve 1 Force when you Force drain at another 'liberated' system.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L5726</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_68</code>, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the PC-E3 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
